name: minnow
description: Local-first AI chat client for LM Studio and OpenAI-compatible providers
author: Grim Media

scripts.impeccable:update: npx impeccable skills update && node scripts/sync-impeccable-skill.mjs
scripts.test:attachments: node --test test/attachments/*.test.mjs test/server/read-document.test.mjs && node --experimental-test-module-mocks ./node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs --import ./test/test-loader.mjs --test test/workspace-ref.test.ts test/workspace-path-composer.test.mts test/attachments/code-ref.test.mts test/attachments/image-path.test.ts test/attachments/reader-routing.test.mts
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron "cross-env BROWSER=none MINNOW_ELECTRON=1 npm run dev" "node scripts/electron-dev.mjs"
scripts.electron:prod: npm run build && npm run electron:build && cross-env MINNOW_ELECTRON=1 electron electron/dist/main.js
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run electron:build && node scripts/electron-builder-run.mjs
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run electron:build && node scripts/electron-builder-run.mjs --dir
